heating_system.title: Heating System
heating_system.description: Select the entities for your heating system. Only Climate and Outdoor Temperature are required — all others are optional.

power.title: Power Monitoring
power.description: Optional: bind power sensors for the heat pump compressor and the electric backup heater (elpatron/tillsatsvärmare). Used to detect when the backup heater is idle before entering Cheap Price mode.

pricing.title: Electricity Pricing
pricing.description: Bind your spot-price sensor (Nord Pool, Tibber, ENTSO-e or template). The optional 'today' sensor enables 96-quarter price analysis — pick the sensor that has a 'prices' attribute with a list of 96 values.

data.price_sensor: Aktuellt spotpris (öre/kWh) – t.ex. Nord Pool SE3 Price

weather.title: Weather Forecast
weather.description: Optional: a daily weather forecast entity (SMHI or equivalent) enables weather-anticipation reduction.

solar.title: Solar / PV
solar.description: Optional: bind PV and battery entities to enable solar-aware optimization.

defaults.title: Default Values
defaults.description: These defaults seed the integration's own number entities. You can change them anytime from the entity UI.

data.price_threshold: Price Threshold (öre/kWh) — above this price 'cheap' never triggers
